params.name: organization_id
params.description: Organization to list events for. Only used by system callers; normal and partner callers are always scoped to their own organization.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter to a single event type. Use GET /api/events_types to list valid values.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Return events created strictly after this timestamp.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Return events created strictly before this timestamp.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default 10, maximum 100.

items.docs:
Lists audit events for the caller's organization.

Results are paginated. If more events are available, the response includes
`pagination.next_page_token`; pass that token back unchanged to continue from
the last item you received.

Filter by event type using the `event_type` query parameter. Pass one of the
identifiers returned by [`GET /api/events_types`](../../api-reference/events/get-types) to
narrow results to a specific category of activity.
